implementation: DocFieldLocation distinguishes SectionId, AnchorId and ReferenceTarget operand positions from the whole node range. Actual parser lowering obtains locations from the Name operand, with no spelling search; source-less constructors retain absent locations.

Article label checking collects declarations before resolving references, retains exact declaration identity, and rejects unknown names and duplicate Section/Anchor names. ForeignClosure syntax is not entered.

Shared Doc DAGs remain valid for label-free content. A Section/Anchor reachable through two display paths is rejected as DuplicateOccurrence. Saturated path counts avoid exponential expansion, and two explicit DocPathStep paths are retained instead of fabricated source ranges.

Typed diagnostics and path arguments use the Doc schema and ordinary Report/CBOR boundary. Structural failures and resource stops retain their original categories; diagnostic-construction failure does not erase the borrowed label failure.
